chief_complaint: Management of hypertension and associated cardiometabolic risk factors (obesity, prediabetes) compounded by recent psychosocial stressors.
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 42-year-old Hispanic male with a long-standing diagnosis of essential hypertension (since 2013) currently controlled on lisinopril 10 mg and amlodipine 2.5 mg. Obesity (BMI ≥ 30) has been documented since 2017. In May 2023 he was newly diagnosed with prediabetes (A1c 6.2%). The same month he reported new onset of part‑time employment, social isolation, chronic stress, and ongoing transportation barriers. He has a refugee background (since 2015) and limited access to reliable transport, which affect his ability to attend appointments and adhere to lifestyle recommendations. No emergency visits have occurred; most encounters are preventive wellness visits. Recent vital signs show controlled blood pressure (110/82 mmHg) but a resting heart rate of 99 bpm. Laboratory data are incomplete (no lipid panel, eGFR, or BMI).
past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include acute infective cystitis (treated April 2023), prior episodes of stress (2018, 2022), previous full‑time and part‑time employment periods, unemployment (2018), and unhealthy alcohol drinking behavior (resolved 2022). No chronic organ‑specific diseases other than the active hypertension, obesity, and prediabetes are documented.
social_determinants: Refugee status, lack of reliable transportation, part‑time employment, social isolation, chronic stress, limited access to resources, and recent changes in employment situation affecting income stability.
risk_factor_summary: Blood pressure controlled at 110/82 mmHg (stage 1 hypertension), heart rate 99 bpm, A1c 6.2% (prediabetic). BMI, lipid panel, eGFR, and smoking status are missing. Charlson comorbidity index is 0; clinical complexity rated moderate. Hypertension flag present. Combined metabolic (obesity, prediabetes) and psychosocial risk factors place the patient at moderate‑to‑high 10‑year ASCVD risk despite current BP control.
